disposition_mapping.rationale: Due-item selection is combined with proposal generation into a single ERP-automated step; it still consumes approved matched invoices and payment terms, satisfying PRE-R-01.
Proposal generation survives as part of the automated TS-01 step (PRE-R-08). Its actor (AP analyst/ERP) remains distinct from the approval actor in TS-03, preserving actor separation (PRE-R-04).

Proposal review survives (PRE-R-09) but is restructured to add automated duplicate-payment, blocked-vendor and bank-detail-change screening ahead of human sign-off, and still precedes payment approval (PRE-R-02) and bank release (PRE-R-03).
Payment approval by an authorised signatory within delegated limits is unchanged (PRE-R-10) and continues to precede file generation and release (PRE-R-05).
Payment file generation and release by treasury survives unchanged (PRE-R-11), occurring only after proposal review and approval.
Bank confirmation receipt is restructured into an automated bank-API matching process (unconstrained by design), still producing the bank settlement confirmation required downstream.

Posting and clearing is restructured with an automated rule engine but retains GL accountant oversight for estimation-sensitive FX difference recognition (KB-04, KB-08, KB-11), still consuming the bank settlement confirmation (PRE-R-06) and settlement-date exchange rate (PRE-R-07).
Remittance advice is restructured into an automated ERP dispatch triggered by settlement confirmation (unconstrained by design), preserving vendor notification of settled invoices.

steps.description: The ERP automatically identifies approved, matched invoices falling due under their payment terms, including foreign-currency items, and immediately generates a payment proposal grouped by vendor, currency and payment method. The AP analyst configures selection parameters and reviews the system output before it passes to review.
steps.name: Due-item selection and payment proposal generation

steps.description: An automated control layer screens the proposal for duplicate payments, blocked vendors and recent vendor bank-detail changes, flagging exceptions into a register. The AP supervisor resolves or holds each flagged exception and signs off the reviewed proposal before it moves to approval or bank release.
steps.name: Proposal review with automated exception detection

steps.description: The reviewed proposal is approved for payment by an authorised signatory within delegated limits, distinct from whoever generated the proposal.
steps.name: Payment approval

steps.description: The approved proposal is converted into a bank payment file and released to the bank, only after proposal review and approval have been completed.
steps.name: Payment file generation and release to bank

steps.actor: Treasury officer (with automated bank API reconciliation)
steps.description: Bank execution confirmations are received via an automated bank-API feed and matched against the transmitted payment file, with the treasury officer resolving any unmatched or exception items.
steps.name: Automated bank confirmation matching

steps.actor: GL accountant (with automated posting rule engine)
steps.description: An automated posting rule engine clears settled payments against open AP subledger items and records cash in the GL, computing foreign-currency settlement differences using the settlement-date exchange rate. The GL accountant reviews and approves estimation-sensitive FX postings before they are finalised.
steps.name: Posting and clearing with FX difference recognition

steps.description: Remittance advice detailing settled invoices is generated and dispatched to vendors automatically by the ERP once settlement confirmation is received, with the AP analyst monitoring delivery failures.
steps.name: Automated remittance advice dispatch
